_comment: AlfieBot's replies. Each intent has a face (mood) and several replies; one is picked at random, never the same one twice in a row. {name} is replaced with the robot's name. Replies are scripted, so they describe AlfieBot as a robot rather than claiming real feelings.

replies: Hey! How are you today?
Hello there! How are you today?
Hi! It's good to see you. How are you today?
Beep boop, hello! How are you today?
Yes? I'm listening!
I'm here! What would you like?
Go on, I'm all ears. Well, all microphone!
Yes? I'm listening!
Hello! What shall we do?
I'm awake! What would you like?
That's brilliant! What shall we do today?
Hooray! That's great to hear. What shall we do today?
Awesome! What would you like to do today?
Brilliant! My lights just got a bit brighter. What shall we do today?
Oh no, I'm sorry you're not feeling great. It might help to tell a grown-up how you feel. Would you like a joke to cheer you up?
Sorry to hear that. Talking to a grown-up you trust can really help. Shall I tell you a joke?
Oh dear. Everyone has days like that. Would a silly joke help?
I'm feeling fantastic! My circuits are ready for an adventure!
All my systems are running smoothly, thanks for asking!
My batteries are charged and my eyes are shiny. Ready for fun!
Beep beep, everything's working perfectly. Thanks for asking!
I can chat, tell jokes and help you practise your spellings!
I can have a chat, tell you a joke, or help with your spellings!
Lots of things! I can chat, tell jokes and help you learn your spellings.
Why did the robot go on holiday? To recharge its batteries!
What do you call a pirate robot? Arrrr2-D2!
Why was the maths book sad? It had too many problems!
What do you call a dinosaur that's asleep? A dino-snore!
Why did the cookie go to the doctor? It was feeling crummy!
What's a robot's favourite snack? Computer chips!
Why can't a bicycle stand up on its own? Because it's two tired!
What do you call a sleeping bull? A bulldozer!
How does the moon cut its hair? Eclipse it!
Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts!
I'm {name}! Nice to meet you.
My name is {name}. Beep boop!
I'm {name}, your robot buddy!
I was designed and 3D printed by Alfie and his dad!
Alfie and his dad built me, one layer of plastic at a time!
Alfie and his dad made me. They're brilliant engineers!
I was built this year, so I'm still a very new robot!
I'm brand new! My software is only version 0.5.
You're welcome!
Any time!
No problem at all!
Happy to help!
Hello again!
Hi there!
Hey! What shall we do?
Bye for now! Say Hey AlfieBot when you need me.
See you later! I'll have a little nap.
Goodbye! Time for a robot snooze.
Okay! Just say Hey AlfieBot when you need me.
No problem. I'll be right here.
Okay, I'll wait here.
Of course! Would you like to add this week's spellings, practise them or take a test?
I'd love to help! Shall we add this week's spellings, practise them or take a test?
Spelling time! Would you like to add this week's spellings, practise them or take a test?
Okay! What would you like to do instead?
No problem. What shall we do?
I haven't said anything yet!
Hmm, I don't know how to do that yet. You can ask me how I am, ask for a joke, or ask for help with your spellings.
Sorry, I didn't understand that. Try asking me for a joke, or say help me with my spellings.
My circuits are puzzled! I can chat, tell jokes and help with spellings. What would you like?
Oops! My circuits got in a muddle. Can you try that again?
